compliance.controlled_movement_rule_vers.reason: The isolated regulatory importer owns exact official controlled-movement rule releases.

compliance.controlled_substance_entries:.reason: The model has no complete effective-dated controlled-substance applicability and counterparty-license authority rules.

compliance.destructions:destructions_cro.reason: The approval row stores no immutable approved batch and quantity snapshot to compare with posted destruction movements.

compliance.recall_batches:recall_batches.reason: Recall inventory context is typed, but exact exposure snapshots and action-total refresh belong to the later reviewed compliance command boundary.

compliance.storage_rule_versions:storage.reason: Reviewed storage-rule activation and non-overlap belong to the compliance command boundary.

compliance.temperature_readings:temperat.reason: No effective-dated product/location storage-rule authority exists for resolving the permitted range, especially for readings without batch_id.

finance.adjustment_note_lines:adjustment.reason: The canonical Decimal engine is not a PostgreSQL function and the catalog stores no independently verifiable calculation proof; a command cannot certify caller-supplied totals.

finance.adjustment_notes:adjustment_note.reason: Atomic orchestration cannot prove exact note/tax totals until the canonical Decimal authority is exposed through a reviewed database-verifiable calculation proof.

finance.expense_claim_lines:expense_clai.reason: No immutable effective-dated receipt-evidence policy exists in the canonical model.

finance.expense_claims:expense_claims_cr.reason: No immutable approver authorization and expense-account mapping policy exists for a posting command to apply.

tax.documents:documents_cross_row_guard.reason: No database-verifiable canonical Decimal proof binds immutable source-line snapshots and calculation rules to the tax document.

tax.einvoice_rule_versions:einvoice_rule.reason: The isolated regulatory importer owns exact official e-invoice rule releases.

tax.einvoices:einvoices_cross_row_guard.reason: IRP response authenticity, signed QR verification, cancellation, and regeneration require a configured external provider and cryptographic verification boundary.

tax.eway_bills:eway_bills_cross_row_guar.reason: E-way authority response authenticity, cancellation, and regeneration require a configured external provider and cryptographic verification boundary.

tax.gst_adjustment_rule_versions:gst_adj.reason: The isolated regulatory importer owns exact official GST adjustment rule releases.

tax.organization_fiscal_tax_facts:organi.reason: Organization turnover, TAN and notified-deductor facts require a reviewed evidence-verification command.

tax.registration_branches:registration_b.reason: A reviewed tax registration association command and posting lookup own this boundary.

tax.withholding_basis_lines:withholding_.reason: Basis rows and cumulative thresholds must be derived by the blocked withholding deduction command, never inserted directly.

tax.withholding_certificate_lines:withho.reason: Certificate coverage must prove exact filed statement-line, deductee, regime, period and amount facts.

tax.withholding_certificates:withholding.reason: Certificate import requires a verified immutable authority artifact and correction lineage.

tax.withholding_deposit_lines:withholdin.reason: Deposit lines must be inserted only while locked residuals and component sums are proven.

tax.withholding_deposits:withholding_dep.reason: Deposit posting requires an exact government payment, verified challan, component allocations and compensating reversal command.

tax.withholding_rule_versions:withholdin.reason: The typed rule table requires an exact-set regulated withholding_rules importer before it can be trusted by posting commands.

tax.withholding_statement_lines:withhold.reason: Statement membership must prove matching deposits and periods.

tax.withholding_statements:withholding_s.reason: Statement filing requires an immutable authority acknowledgement and exact append-only revision population command.

tax.withholdings:withholdings_cross_row_.reason: The typed rule and basis model exists, but no reviewed command yet selects the exact imported rule, derives cumulative thresholds, posts accounting/allocation effects, and reverses them atomically.
